hookups.source: https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Withlacoochee-State-Forest/Recreation-at-Withlacoochee-State-Forest ('Campsites with concrete pads, electricity, water, picnic table and fire ring') + ReserveAmerica site details for parkId 1120172 (all 27 campsites 'Electricity Hookup: 30/50', 25 'Water Hookup: Y'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 27 'RV or Tent' sites, all back-in, concrete pads; listed vehicle lengths 20-40 ft (10 at 40 ft, 4 at 35, the rest 20-30). Plus a pavilion for paid campers.

sites.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/holder-mine-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120172 (28 units: 27 RV or Tent, 1 Pavilion; each site's Max Vehicle Length and Access Type: Back-In), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/holder-mine-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120172 ('campsites with electric and potable water, bathhouse with restroom and showers, dump station and pavilion') + FDACS ('Dump station for registered campers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Florida Forest Service campground on its own ReserveAmerica site (or 1-877-879-3859): 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance' (window shown Oct 21 2026 to Sep 21 2027). All sites are site-specific. Cancelling 1 or more days before arrival costs a $9 non-refundable fee.

The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for people 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and the 100% disabled 'at applicable camping facilities'; documentation is registered by calling (877) 879-3859.

discounts.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/holder-mine-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120172 ('The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for individuals age 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and for individuals 100% disabled at applicable camping facilities'), read 2026-10-21

note: Small campground in the Citrus Tract of Withlacoochee State Forest, shaded by live and turkey oaks in an upland setting, not directly on water; popular with hunters during archery and small-game seasons. The forest service says to follow its directions (Pleasant Grove Rd south from SR 44 in Inverness, then west on Forest Road/Trail 10), not Google Maps. --Claude
summary: Changed hookups electric 0 (derived, wrong) -> 50 with water: FDACS and ReserveAmerica both list electric and water at every campsite. Added 27 back-in sites to 40 ft, bathhouse showers, dump station, potable water, open year-round, ReserveAmerica booking same-day to 11 months, the FFS military/veteran discount.
